characters.continuity: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series, plus tie-in comics
characters.summary: Sharon Carter is a highly skilled former S.H.I.E.L.D. agent and CIA operative who operates as an elite martial artist, marksman, and tactical strategist. After becoming a fugitive following the Sokovia Accords, she established herself as the criminal mastermind known as the Power Broker in Madripoor, commanding vast resources and private enforcers.

techniques: Undercover infiltration and orchestration of hits

weaknesses: Vulnerable to betrayal by criminal associates
Standard human physical vulnerability (was shot by Karli Morgenthau at the GRC; subdued by Bucky Barnes in close combat)

depictions.title: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

limitations: Normal human physical limits without specialized gear
Human physiology lacks superhuman durability or strength

sources.supports: Agent 13 background, CIA service, and Power Broker role in Madripoor.
Combat encounters in Madripoor and firearm proficiency.

MCU Wiki page for Sharon Carter: hand-to-hand and firearms skill, undercover work as nurse "Kate", being subdued by Barnes in Civil War, beating the Madripoor bounty hunters, shooting Batroc dead at the GRC, and manipulating all sides as the Power Broker.
MCU character history: S.H.I.E.L.D. Agent 13, CIA, retrieving Rogers' shield and Wilson's wingsuit, fugitive life in Madripoor as the Power Broker, killing Batroc and Morgenthau.

feats.claim: Defeated multiple bounty hunters in Madripoor using close-quarters combat and weaponry.
feats.citation: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier episode 3
feats.depiction: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

feats.claim: Maintained an undercover nurse persona to observe Steve Rogers undetected.

feats.depiction: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

notableResults.depiction: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

notableResults.note: Beat every one of them with knife and gun while helping Wilson, Barnes and Zemo escape.
At the Joint Counter Terrorist Centre, Barnes (under HYDRA programming) countered her attack and threw her onto a table, subduing her.

notableResults.citation: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
notableResults.note: During the GRC attack Batroc tried to blackmail her; she shot him dead without hesitation. Not a prolonged fight.

notableResults.citation: The Falcon and the Winter Soldier

characters.summary: Jennifer Walters is a talented attorney who gained gamma-irradiated superhuman strength, durability, and regenerative healing after cross-contamination with Bruce Banner's blood. As She-Hulk, she combines immense physical power with legal intellect, maintaining her full cognitive faculties while transformed.

mechanisms: Superhuman durability against ballistic and physical attacks

weaknesses: Prone to emotional spikes affecting transformation stability

depictions.title: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

limitations: Requires anger or conscious trigger to transform initially, though later controlled
Needed training from Bruce Banner to control her Hulk form; rage can still trigger destructive outbursts (destroyed the gala stage when provoked)

sources.supports: Origin via Bruce Banner's blood, lawyer profession, and gamma powers.
Feats against Titania and Asgardian construction crew.

Episode summaries: origin via Banner's blood, handling Banner's training, easily defeating Titania in the courtroom, fighting off four attackers with Asgardian construction equipment, a later brief fight with Titania, destroying the gala stage in a rage, and the finale fight.
Bruce Banner trains Walters to control her Hulk form; the two get into a fight before he accepts her leaving.

characters.summary: Shuri is Wakanda's premier scientific genius and innovator, utilizing advanced vibranium technology, sonic weaponry, and energy gauntlets in combat. Following the loss of her family, she synthesized a synthetic heart-shaped herb to ingest, granting herself the superhuman attributes and mantle of the Black Panther.

techniques: Hand-to-hand combat utilizing Black Panther enhancements

weaknesses: Reliance on advanced technology and vibranium supply
Vulnerable to powerful sonic frequencies or extreme magnetic manipulation
Without the herb's powers she had ordinary human durability: Corvus Glaive knocked her unconscious and Killmonger nearly killed her

depictions.title: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

mobility: Enhanced acrobatic leaps and running speed via Black Panther augmentation
limitations: Kinetic suit storage capacity can be overloaded if energy input exceeds threshold
Before Wakanda Forever she had no superhuman abilities and relied on her gauntlets and other technology

sources.supports: Role as Wakanda's lead scientist and ascension to Black Panther.
Vibranium gauntlets, synthetic heart-shaped herb ingestion, and duel with Namor.

Wikipedia article on MCU Shuri: designs T'Challa's vibration-absorbent suit, heals Everett Ross with vibranium technology, cuts power to N'Jadaka's suit, interrupted by Corvus Glaive, gains Black Panther powers via the synthetic herb and defeats then spares Namor.

Official Marvel on-screen profile: no superhuman abilities, vibranium gauntlets firing concentrated energy blasts, kinetic-absorbing Black Panther suit, nearly killed by Killmonger, knocked unconscious by Corvus Glaive.

feats.claim: Fired concentrated energy blasts from vibranium gauntlets in combat.

characters.summary: Lady Sif is an elite Asgardian warrior and loyal ally of Thor, renowned for her exceptional swordsmanship, tactical prowess in battle, and fearlessness against frost giants and cosmic threats. She wields a double-bladed sword and a traditional heater shield.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to high-tier cosmic entities and magic
Susceptible to mortal wounds if caught off guard

depictions.title: Marvel Cinematic Universe films and Disney+ series

mobility: Asgardian running speed and leaping ability
limitations: Physical mortality despite Asgardian longevity and resilience
Her sword had little effect when she impaled the Destroyer
